<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 182.073 (likely the [M+H]⁺ ion), the neutral mass is ≈181.066 Da. The formula C₆H₁₃O₆ matches this mass within experimental error (neutral mass ≈ 181.071 Da, [M+H]⁺ ≈ 182.078 Da). This is the best fit among plausible C/H/O combinations, so the molecular formula is C6H13O6.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H13O6</final_answer>
